Management Plan

- Heart failure symptom management: Increase furosemide to one tablet twice daily for the next few days to address dyspnea and ankle swelling.
- Investigations: Arrange blood tests (FBC, renal function/electrolytes). Order echocardiogram to reassess cardiac function.
- Follow-up: Review in 1 week to assess response and review results. Earlier review advised if symptoms worsen.
- Safety-netting: Seek urgent care or contact clinic sooner for worsening breathlessness, new chest pain, palpitations, or dizziness.
- Work: Acknowledged concerns about impact on work; plan aims to stabilize symptoms promptly.

- Internal contradictions: Beta-blocker name briefly unclear (clinician asked about metoprolol; patient stated bisoprolol) — conflict noted. Examination referenced as “OK” without documented measurements.
- Transcript quality: Occasional audio dropouts/connection issues; some responses incomplete or unclear; no numeric values provided for vitals.
